text: {"sql":"SELECT p.category, SUM((oi.unit_price - p.cost) * oi.quantity) AS gross_profit FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY gross_profit DESC","unanswerable":false,"unanswerableReason":""}
